name: Vanity heirlooms need a level 60 on the realm to be delivered and equipped
contract: Heirloom quality items of VanityCollection.dbc follow Aura of Experience (818059): while no character on the account has reached level 60, the Vanity collection's Deliver Item request (CMSG_CUSTOM_ASCENSION_POINT_SPEND_REQUEST 0x0523, u8 currency 2, u32 item) hands over nothing and an owned copy cannot be equipped. A level 59 character on the account is not enough. CoA.UnlockAllVanity is on in the test realm, so the character is entitled to every vanity entry. Once another character of the account is saved at level 60, Pendant of Discovery (339100) is delivered and Pendant of Adventure (339076) goes into the neck slot.

steps.label: A level 59 character on the account does not unlock heirloom delivery
An owned vanity heirloom cannot be equipped without a level 60 on the account
A saved level 60 character on the account unlocks heirloom delivery
A saved level 60 character on the account lets the alt equip the heirloom
